method.streets: OpenStreetMap ways with highway=living_street/motorway/motorway_link/pedestrian/primary/primary_link/residential/road/secondary/secondary_link/service/tertiary/tertiary_link/trunk/trunk_link/unclassified (klasse strasse) and bridleway/corridor/cycleway/footway/path/steps/track (klasse weg), with a name; ways of one name within 250 m are one street
method.sides: seite_a/seite_b are named after the compass side of the street axis; rough for winding streets
method.quarter: nearest OSM place point (suburb, quarter, neighbourhood, village, hamlet) to the middle of the street
